parts.text: At the Learning to Adapt, Learning with Agency Lab (LaLa Lab) at Saarland University/Saarland Informatics Campus (

), we are looking for a 2-year Postdoctoral Fellow joining as a Humboldt Postdoctoral Fellow, funded by the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation (start date flexible within early-mid 2027)

Our lab conducts interdisciplinary work at the intersection of the Learning Sciences and Human-Computer Interaction (

) to (co-)design and evaluate AI-based learning systems, and we are particularly looking for someone with quantitative analytical skills with training in psychology, education, HCI, cognitive science, or related field. You would be doing an independent study, while exploring collaborations with two other fellows (Dr. Krithik Ranjan

). Comes with your own funding of roughly 20,000 euros that you can spend freely (to simulate a “mini PI” experience)!
